messages:
tara: Heads-up — on iOS Safari when you tap a table filter input the virtual keyboard pushes up and our sticky header overlaps the input. Screenshot attached (phone safe-area + keyboard).

mike: Repro'd on iPhone 12 / iOS 16.5. Header is position:sticky; top:0 so it doesn't respect the visual viewport when keyboard opens.

olivia: Also seeing the focus ring on row actions get cut off — so keyboard cover + sticky header combo is breaking focus visibility.

james: Short-term patch idea: add safe-area offsets + detect visualViewport resize. Long-term: test Visual Viewport API and adjust scrollIntoView behavior. Quick CSS patch to try:

```css
.console-header {
  top: env(safe-area-inset-top); /* fallback for notch */
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .table-wrapper {
    padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom); /* avoid keyboard overlap */
  }
}
```

aria: Accessibility note — when keyboard opens we should call `focusedRow.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' })` using visual viewport dims so keyboard doesn't hide the element. Also ensure focused element has a visible focus style that's not clipped.

design-bot: Design review agenda updated: add "mobile keyboard + sticky header" and "table focus / overflow" for 2026-03-24 10:00.

tara: Also proposing a breakpoint tweak: collapse table columns / switch to stacked view at 600px instead of 768px. Most phones we test are <640 and look cramped at 768.

mike: I support moving the compact breakpoint to 600px. Also table overflow behavior: horizontal scroll feels bad — prefer column priority + wrap/truncate with show-more for long tokens. Keep ID and action columns sticky.

olivia: Copy nits for the empty results state: current text is "No data" — suggest "No results match your filters" and add a secondary button "Clear filters" (aria-label="Clear filters"). Screen readers should announce the number of results too.

james: UX nit: the hamburger / back control is too close to the top safe-area on some phones — increase touch target to 44px and offset it by 8px from the top inset.

tara: Proposed rollout: 1) interim patch for header + keyboard overlap + copy tweak, 2) design review to nail breakpoint & sidebar pattern, 3) implementation of column-priority table behavior.

aria: I'll add an a11y checklist to the ticket: focus order, visible focus, announce empty state, ensure the Clear filters button is reachable by keyboard and screen readers.

olivia: :thumbsup: I'll create the ticket and attach repro steps + screenshots.

mike: Filing now: ticket INFR-4123 — added labels mobile, a11y, ux. I'll take the safe-area CSS + scrollIntoView patch in this sprint.

design-bot: Reminder — include device model, iOS version, and steps to repro in the ticket.

james: Quick question — for the collapsed sidebar pattern on very narrow screens are we leaning toward a bottom sheet or off-canvas drawer? I prefer off-canvas for quick toggles.

tara: Off-canvas seems better for nav density, bottom sheet is ok for quick actions. We'll discuss in the review and set a single pattern.

olivia: Cool. I'll add mock screenshots for both patterns to the review doc so we can vote.

mike: On it — pushing a small CSS patch to stage for QA after lunch.

tara: Thanks everyone — let's keep the interim fixes small so mobile users get immediate relief.
